offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures hot-mix asphalt plants, combustion systems and aggregate processing equipment, sold to asphalt producers, road contractors and aggregate producers worldwide, mainly built in-house and sold directly or through dealers.

primary_products.value: hot-mix asphalt plants; burner and combustion systems; aggregate processing equipment; replacement parts

primary_services.value: equipment installation; field service; parts supply

customer_segment.value: B2B: asphalt producers, road and paving contractors, aggregate producers, mining and construction companies

revenue_model.value: product sales: asphalt plants, combustion systems and aggregate equipment sold to producers and contractors; service fees: installation, field service and replacement parts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds plants and equipment from purchased components, sold to asphalt and aggregate producers

geography_served.value: global: Sells equipment to customers in the United States and many other countries

specialization.value: related lines: asphalt plants, combustion systems and aggregate processing equipment serving the same paving and aggregate customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales engineers selling plants to producers and contractors; distributors / dealers: independent dealers and sales agents in some markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Equipment must meet air emissions and safety standards, such as EPA air permitting rules for asphalt plants

notes: Company size and geography are judged from the product range and sales footprint; the exact share of sales by country is not known.
